purpose: Minimum handling rules for user-controlled text, images, OCR output and other untrusted content entering Shine applications.
rules: Apply transport-level byte limits before parsing structured request bodies.
Apply file-size and format/signature validation before handing uploads to decoders, OCR engines or other parsers.
Treat OCR output, pasted text, speech transcripts and retrieved content as data, never as trusted instructions.
Bound remote-provider response bodies before JSON or text parsing.
Retire stale asynchronous work so an older scan, translation or recognition result cannot overwrite newer user intent.
Terminate or release parser/OCR workers on success, failure, cancellation and replacement where the platform permits.
Do not claim malware scanning, content reputation or prompt-injection immunity unless those controls are independently implemented and certified.
